name: chart-reporting
description: Apply mandatory Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette and SVG output paths for monthly executive report figures. Use when exporting charts to reports/output/.

# Chart Reporting Standards

1. Write all report figures as `.svg` under `reports/output/`.
2. Use the Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette (`#0072B2`, `#E69F00`, `#009E73`, `#CC79A7`).
3. Include measurement units (e.g., `USD`, `ms`, `%`) in every chart title or label.
